review_description: Joel & Daniel was easy to talk to and answered all of my questions since the begining. Initially we wanted to install a Tesla system however Zap Tech team recommended Sigenergy and we couldn't be happier with the change because of the value for money. Installation took place about 4 weeks after the initial quote. Installation itself took over 2 days and Jordan & the team were very professional, everyone was quite quiet and reserved. It's been a week since the instal now and I can say that we love the Sigenergy system. Thanks Zap Tech & team! Highly recommend these guys.

Appreciated the transparent discussion about all of the options when we were quoting up a system.The install was a very big job and the guys worked. diligently for five days through a pretty crappy weather.They were happy to answer questions, were really polite, and ultimately did a great job.

When compared to several other solar installers I contactwd through the quotation process, Zap Tech were a standout. Working with Josh to find the right system size and the right brands for each component felt very reassuring and well explained. We eventually landed on a system that feels perfect for what I am after, and I couldn't be happier with the whole process. Installation was a breeze, and everything was put in place with a high standard of professionalism and care. Very pleased that I went with Zap Tech for my solar system and would definitely recommend to everyone.

The advice I received from Josh was excellent he didnt try to sell me anything I didnt need.The installation was on time professionally completed and signed off from the inspector without any issues.Customer service was on point always available for my many questions the team at Zap Tech Energy answered everyone without hesitation.The team gave me thorough handover explaining everything I needed to know about the system.

Right from the start Josh and Daniel were on the ball. Any enquiry I made was answered within 15 minutes or less, sometimes immediately. When it came to the installation Jordan and the crew were efficient, polite and tidy. No need to ask them to remove their boots on coming inside they had already removed them as a matter of course. Overall we are extremely happy with the process and the installation and highly recommend Zap Tech.

Daniel from Zap Tech was punctual and professional in managing the installation of solar panels and sigenstore battery in a timely manner. He organised the grid connection with the electricity supplier and explained how the app could track the solar power generation in and out of our property. Also he confirmed how the existing solar power and inverter would be integrated with the new battery and the hybrid inverter.
All aspects were great.Would highly recommend JoshMost professional in every aspect.
Josh has been very prompt to respond and accommodating. Installation was smooth. No issue whatsoever so far. Highly recommneded!
Josh and the team were great to work with throughout the process from start to finish. No nonsense, turned up on time and left site clean and tidy.

Josh and Daniel have been fantastic to deal with. They came onsite for a quote and have great communication. They turned up when they said and the installation was smooth. We got solar and an EV charger installed. Everything was organised well and followed up when needed. Have had the system for about 6 months with no dramas. One small fault that they noticed through online monitoring before I did and they have already organised the warranty replacement. So impressed that they are keeping up with how my system is running 6 months after install. Great to work with.

Honest, hard working, informative, professional and meticulous! Very happy with both the great job they did and all my interactions with Josh ,Joel and his team. I had zero worries on a fair price and workmanship, and my roof has a 35 degree pitch, which many installers absolutely refused to look at doing. I’m also set up for a battery installation down the track, and wouldn’t hesitate to to use Zap Solar again.

I had gotten multiple quotes for a solar battery install and finally went with Zap Tech. Their customer service has been friendly, honest and professional.The install was done earlier than I had expected and the site crew were polite and efficient while here. There was nothing to clean up afterwards and they spent time explaining the system to me once it was setup.I would highly recommend them for any project.

We have a complicated roof, three storey, lots of shading issues. Josh was quick to respond and was the only one of all those who tendered to come to 'walk the roof' to see how to make it work, rather than looking at satellite/Nearmap images. Helped us design a system that would work, had some future expandability to it, and was frank about what would be a waste of money. Ended up with about 5 quotes which were all in a similar ballpark despite some having lower spec kit than Zap Tech were offering. Daniel and team did a great job on the install - all very neat and professional and helped with the grid connection post install. Now working well, arguably better than I expected given the challenges we have. The apps we got with the systems are very helpful. The only slight glitch in the whole experience was the invoicing which ended up being a bit messy due to timing of when the battery STCs could be claimed. But overall great experience and am thinking of using them again for other things.
Yes, the installer went through the operational procedures and basic time frame for the system to be inspected and be turned on.
Sales and quoting was straight forward. Josh answered all my questions. Dan came out to visit and provided an overview of how the install and panels would work

Josh was incredibly responsive throughout the quote process. He called me and got all the details he needed and sent through a quote, then we discussed it and I ended up having him send through a couple of variations. He answered all of my questions thouroughly and it was clear he wanted to do what he could to make sure I was happy with everything. Any time I contacted him he was very quick to respond. The team doing the installation turned up right on time and got to work quickly. They were friendly, worked efficiently and were very tidy (no mess or anything left behind when they were gone). The panels, wiring, battery etc all looks really neat and tidy, and once it was all ready they got me set up on the app and showed me how everything works.On top of all that their pricing was competitve with other quotes we got. There really is nothing I could fault them on.

Sales/quoting process was great. They contacted me after requesting quote to find out the size of solar panels and battery.Installtion was trouble free. The installation was over 2 days. The install crew turned up on time, were polite and left everything tidy after departure.Customer service was great. They organised the grid connection. They showed me how to use and monitor the new system.

We decided to use Zap Tech Energy to install a PV & battery system on my father's unit because they offered the best advice, equipment quality and price during our quoting process. Josh was very helpful in determining the best system configuration to go with and was always very quick to respond to any clarification or follow up question we had. The pricing and rebate process was handled very professionally and the installation followed very quickly. It ran very smoothly and the installation team worked diligently and cleaned up carefully at the conclusion of the job. The whole process went without a hitch and we are happy to recommend Zap Tech Energy as an ethical, conscientious team who deliver what they say they will. Thanks to the whole team.

Quoting process was excellent, provided with multiple options, very happy to discuss different technologies available. Upfront about costs involved and any potential difficulties that could occur. Installation team was punctual, professional and very polite. Provided all details about using the system and connected to App on day of installation. I highly recommend Zap Tech Energy.

From the usages quote all the way through to the installation and handover (there was a slight delay in getting our system to work due to tech issues), Zap Tech Energy was great to deal with. They listened carefully to our needs and what we were hoping to achieve, designed a system to meet this and then flexed at the last minute when we decided to upgrade to a larger battery twice. They were also cognisant of the  restrictions that we faced with our local council (we are in a heritage overlay) and were able to design around those restrictions and still find a way to let us maximise our output. Installation was efficient, looks super neat and they left the place tidy.

I was in contact with a couple people at Zap Tech and have only good things to say about them.Very quick and clear with all communications, would answer any questions I had in a very professional and prompt manner.The quality of work I could not be happier with, every bit of work done has clearly been done with attention to detail and with the goal of a clean installation in mind. The install was also done completely within the timeline without any delays or extra costsThe quoting process was handled fantastically, where my install was difficult and turned down by most other companies, Zap Tech pulled through and were able to do both solar and battery for me

Josh from Zap Tech was the first to call me after my SolarQuotes submission. I was unsure what I needed and didn't truly understand what was required, but Josh ran me through everything, informing me along way, and very quickly had us aligned on a path to a good outcome. I found Josh's no nonsense approach extremely valuable. It was clear that for the success and brand of the business he has worked hard to build that he was looking for a job that was mutually beneficial and made sense. This was so refreshing, and screamed out to me that he had quality and success in mind. Josh has an excellent balance of being firm but fair, and is not afraid to challenge. When he does, he educates in explaining his position. It was obvious Zap Tech were excellent at this, and I decided on them very quickly.I changed my mind on a few things through the process, mostly battery sizing, but no one got frustrated, they just dealt with the supply issues to get me what I needed.The installation was led by Joel and his team. They were respectful and polite around our household, considerate of noise and inconvenience to my children, and most importantly have produced a high quality installation. It was effortless on my behalf, they just dealt with everything, let the place clean and tidy as they found it, and even bought my attention to some property issues beyond their scope that they had noticed.Since the installation Zap Tech has dealt with everything. Inspections, permits, everything has just been arranged and ran like clockwork. I am delighted with my choice in Zap Tech. I highly recommend them.

I searched high and low for a solar and battery business that was willing to come and look at our job before quoting, who knew their stuff and could provide expert and considered advice.Zap Tech have been fantastic to deal with. Josh was the only tradesman who actually got up on the roof and looked properly at the job. The advice on right-sizing the system was sound, and I appreciated the follow-up check-ins when I was equivocating on a decision.As people rushed to buy batteries and stock became scarce, I was kept up to date. When the solar and battery installation dates came around, the team turned up on time, worked diligently, and cleaned up after themselves. I rarely write reviews, but I’m happy to recommend Zap Tech.
Great customer service and professional. Arranged install within a week of quote.

Josh was quick to respond, and very patient with me as we went back and forth on the details of our difficult roof/location. I particularly appreciated the thought he put into getting the most out of our panels with the large amount of shading we have.The installation happened extremely quickly, and appeared (to my eye) to be done well.After getting all the framing on the roof, my partner and I had a robust debate, and ended up requesting that a panel be relocated for aesthetic reasons. Josh was happy to accommodate and they moved the frame, rewired, and got all the panels on in half a day.Site was left clean. Just looking forward to seeing how it all performs now!

very friendly and knowledgeable. I had heaps of questions during the quotation process and they were always happy to provide advice. Communication during install was very good. The quality of install was very good. All rubbish was taken away. No complaints.

Zap Tech were great! They were the only installer who came out to our property to provide a quote. Provided us multiple options. Their support during the application process was invaluable. Kept us updated throughout, even when there were some delays during the grant process. We ended up going with the 8.8kw system with the 13 kw Tesla Powerwall 3. Really professional team and great service! Also went the extra mile by installing some roof tiles that we bought to replace ones were already broken or broke during install. Really honest too - realised they hadn’t accounted for the PV rebate and contacted us to organise a refund.Highly recommend the team at Zap Tech!

Josh and the entire team were amazing.  From the first time we spoke Josh was extremely knowledgable and helpful.  ZAP were the only people to attend my house to quote the installation.  This removed any ambiguity in costs or the need for variations.  Whilst not the cheapest the knowledge shared throughout the process gave me comfort in what I was buying not only the equipment but also how it was going to be installed.The team arrived when they said they would quickly getting to work and moving through the tasks required.  There was not a single hiccup during the installation with everything going exactly to plan.The system is in place now 26kw battery with 16kw of solar on our roof it looks amazing, the old system taken away, broken roof tiles replaced during the process (new tiles supplied by me) but the care and workmanship shown throughout the whole process was incredible.We are so very happy with our new system and would highly recommend Josh and the team at ZAP for anyone looking for solar and or battery installation.

The company contacted us very soon after Solar Quotes sent them our information. They visited the site within a couple of days and explained what they would do. They submitted a quote shortly afterwards, which was at a level we were expecting. The whole process took only about a week. The installation went well on the day and they clearly had lots of experience.
Great service and the only company that came out and did a proper site inspection. Very happy with the quick efficient installation and setup.

Quote was prompt and explained thoroughly using quality components and on time as stated.Installation was initially little late on the day due to major panels etc held up from supplier.Installers did all prep possible and job was completed timely when supplier delivered the key elements.Full explanation given at end of job with ongoing contact  made available.Would not hesitate to recommend the full service of the Installers Zap Tech Energy.

Great company. Josh and Daniel and their team are very professional, super responsive and feel like you get value for money. We went to various companies and they came back with the best proposition. We went with solar and EV charger and price also highly competitive.Have kept in touch and provided great post sales support.Highly recommend.

They were the only company, that took the time to come out and inspect the roof, SWB location, asses where the Powerwall would be installed.Quote was good value for money, not the cheapest, but provided the best service.They had to get United Energy to reassess the Tesla Powerwall 3, which was a bit slow at the start, but they followed through every step, and kept us informed.We established a payment plan from the start, which made it easy to manage the finances

Josh and Dan were very professional, detailed oriented and extremely helpful when asking for the best tailored solution for my needs.I got close to ten quotes but Zap were the only people interested in inspecting my home before providing a quote, other we're only guessing based on satelite images and my poor knowledge about my switchboard.Definitely recommend them and will have them back when I need a battery or EV charger installed

The boys showed up on time, did a great job explaining every part, they were honest upfront about it all. The installation was great, they were efficient and able to show me how everything worked. They were also quick to answer the couple of questions I had.

I chose the guys at Zap Tech as they are installers themselves, so not just someone getting subcontracted by a solar company. They aren’t guys who’ll turn up in suits with folders showing you samples of panels, they’ll actually pull a ladder out and get up on your roof. I didn’t get a sales pitch from them, it was just genuine, factual information about what will work best for my home. They use quality products and are prices competitively. They answered any questions and adjusted quotes as needed whenever I asked. They were punctual and didn’t waste my time. The guys are down to Earth and don’t give you spin. I really respected that and would happily suggest them to friends and family. Couldn’t be happier with my install!
Started with site visit, communicated, explained everything, kept their word, respectful, good workmanship

These young men were very well spoken and well presented. It was a pleasure to have them install my new solar system, they all arrived on time and made sure that I had a quality solar system. I went to clean up some of the mess but one of the young men let me know they would handle the mess, and that they did! They left my property clean of any rubbish and even swept the floors in the areas they worked on. Once they had finished putting the panels on they showed me everything I needed to know and answered all of my questions :)
Each step was explained extremely well and great instructions given.

Walked me through/explained why they designed my system happy to answer all my questions. The way they presented their self, as not just the owners but installer’s as well was on point!Better then just dealing with sales men that don’t care, about the end result or what product goes on the house.Over all great team very approachable.

Zap Tech Energy - Josh / Daniel came out onsite and inspected the property before the install.  Paperwork was a breeze and all explained, booked a date and time, turned up on time, installed the system without any issues.I cannot say how professional and impressed I was and would highly recommend this company to you.Great job guysWell done!

The legends at zaptech were amazing from start to finish!They did an exceptional job finding me the perfect solution for my needs so I could make the most out of my solar and battery!The boys were very polite and eager to get job done working efficiently with everything cleaned up perfectly at the end.I couldn’t fault them with there service , even after the install was completed i had a few questions regarding the app and there were more then happy to help!5 stars , highly recommended!!!!
